canon_source: B5 P1 (Enhanced with B6 hero textures)
rationale: B5 P1 establishes the magical emergence of the birthday cake in Chapter 4. Its iconic two-tier architecture makes it distinctly recognizable as a celebratory centerpiece. Incorporating B6's delicate floral side stamps, scalloped cream dollop piping, and gold pearl accents produces a unified, luxurious, and emotionally resonant design across all boards.

top_tier.side_decorations: Four-petal pink peony cherry blossoms (#E85D75) and small golden pearl dots (#F7C704)
top_tier.top_rim: Curved ring of fluffy ivory cream swirls/dollops (#FFF8EF) with pink shading
top_tier.candle_platform: Level ivory cream disk designed to seat the number '23' candle upright without obstruction

bottom_tier.frosting: Pale pastel pink buttercream (#FDECEF) with hand-drawn pink peony floral silhouettes (#EB8DB7)
bottom_tier.base_rim: Rich scalloped pink cream piping with delicate white pearls
bottom_tier.floral_nest: Lush blooming pink and blush-white peonies (#D66D98, #F7CFD8) flanked by delicate white baby's breath blossoms and deep emerald leaves (#2D5A43)

plate.style: Elegant ivory/cream porcelain plate with gentle scalloped fluted rim (#FFF8EF) and subtle warm gold trim (#E2B755)
plate.presence_rule: Present in B6 P1, B7 P3, and B8 P1 resting flat on the table surface. In B5 P1, the cake is caught mid-emergence through the laptop screen portal surrounded by golden ribbons and peony petals, entering onto the scalloped plate as it touches down.

table_props_distinction.peony_bouquet: In B6 P1 and B8 P1, the wrapped pink peony bouquet is a distinct standalone gift on the table, separate from the cake itself.

line_art.stroke_weight: Medium bold (median 7.5px - 8px), hand-inked ligne claire contour, zero mechanical aliasing
